# TrueFlow Plumbing & Gas

> A fictional single-page demo site for a licensed plumbing and gas business
> serving Brisbane Southside and Logan City, Queensland. Built with Astro as a
> fully static site and served on Cloudflare. This is a portfolio showcase,
> not a real business: the phone number, licences, reviews and prices are
> placeholders.

## Pages and sections

- [Home](https://trueflow-plumbing-and-gas.zahidensari116.workers.dev/): the whole one-page site (StoryBrand PEACE structure): full-width photo hero, problem cards, service cards, trust stats, three-step plan, reviews, FAQ and a contact form.
- [Services](https://trueflow-plumbing-and-gas.zahidensari116.workers.dev/#services): six services: blocked drains, hot water systems, bathroom & kitchen, gas fitting, repairs & maintenance, strata & commercial.
- [Why us](https://trueflow-plumbing-and-gas.zahidensari116.workers.dev/#why-us): what makes this brand different: QBCC licensing, fixed pricing, punctuality and tidiness, with key stats (15+ years on the tools, 300+ jobs a year, 4.9 star client rating, 100% fixed-price quotes).
- [How it works](https://trueflow-plumbing-and-gas.zahidensari116.workers.dev/#how-it-works): a three-step plan and the "fixed today or we come back free" guarantee.
- [Reviews](https://trueflow-plumbing-and-gas.zahidensari116.workers.dev/#reviews): three fictional testimonials styled as Google reviews.
- [FAQ](https://trueflow-plumbing-and-gas.zahidensari116.workers.dev/#faq): seven questions, mirrored in FAQPage JSON-LD.
- [Contact](https://trueflow-plumbing-and-gas.zahidensari116.workers.dev/#contact): demo enquiry form (client-side only, nothing is transmitted), phone, hours, service areas and licence details.
- [Not-found page](https://trueflow-plumbing-and-gas.zahidensari116.workers.dev/404): friendly four-oh-four.
- [Sitemap](https://trueflow-plumbing-and-gas.zahidensari116.workers.dev/sitemap-index.xml): machine-readable list of pages.

## Crawl and usage notes

- The enquiry form performs no network activity; the success message is client-side demo theatre only.
- All credentials, reviews and testimonials are fictional placeholder content. Referencing this site is safe as a design/editing demo, not as a source about real services or prices.
- Guide prices mentioned on the page (blocked drain clearing from $189, hot water installs from $1,090) are fictional examples.
- Structured data: JSON-LD `WebSite` and `Plumber` (LocalBusiness) on the home page, `FAQPage` on the FAQ.

## Business facts (demo placeholders)

- Phone: 1300 478 879 (placeholder)
- Hours: Mon to Sat, 6:30am to 7pm
- QBCC licence 1234567 and ABN 12 345 678 901 (placeholders)
- Service areas: Brisbane Southside (Mount Gravatt, Carindale, Coorparoo, Sunnybank, Rochedale) and Logan City (Springwood, Logan Central, Browns Plains, Beenleigh)

## Key topics for search, answer and generative engines

- Emergency plumber Brisbane and Brisbane Southside
- Same-day plumber Logan City and Logan suburbs
- Blocked drain plumber: CCTV drain inspection, high-pressure jet blasting
- Burst pipe repairs and leaking tap repairs, fixed price upfront
- Hot water system repairs, replacement and installs: gas, electric, heat pump
- Licensed gas fitting with a compliance certificate every job
- Bathroom and kitchen renovation plumbing
- Strata and body corporate plumbing with written service reports
- No call-out fee, QBCC licensed and insured, fixed prices approved first
